#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""KinDER i00 control script. Service episode persists across invocations; actions are logged in output/actions.jsonl."""
import json, os, time
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = '/app/output'
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()

def observe(tag='obs', depth=True):
    res = r.get_obs(cameras=['robot_base','robot_wrist'], include_depth=depth, video='none')
    for cam, frame in res.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(f'{OUT}/{tag}_{cam}.jpg')
    if depth and hasattr(res, 'depth'):
        for cam, d in res.depth.items():
            np.save(f'{OUT}/{tag}_{cam}_depth.npy', d)
    print(json.dumps({'tag':tag,'meta':res.meta,'status':r.status()}))
    return res

def act(rows, note=''):
    a = np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32)
    if a.ndim == 1: a = a[None, :]
    res = r.submit('delta', a, cameras=['robot_base','robot_wrist'], video='none', include_depth=True, note=note)
    with open(f'{OUT}/actions.jsonl','a') as f:
        f.write(json.dumps({'note':note,'actions':a.tolist(),'meta':res.meta})+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({'note':note,'meta':res.meta,'status':r.status()}))
    return res

if __name__ == '__main__':
    observe('initial')
